how: Voiced locally in a Claude session, no Actions run: the voice script from episode_build.voice_script (each line in its speaker's Kokoro voice: narration am_michael, Adam am_fenrir, Eve af_heart, God am_onyx at 0.9), then pilot_render.py voice with the preserved hash-pinned Kokoro v1.0 model (the same runtime episode.yml installs). Each line's length is its sentences from the first word to the last word in timeline.json; the lines are laid end to end with the line gap and the 1.2 s tail, as the plan estimate does.

runs.name: first draft text, Short line gap 0.35 s
runs.plan_estimate_then: 879.9 s at the Short's single 2.75 words/s and 0.35 s gap: 5 % long
runs.reading: the narrator ran 2.874 words/s, not 2.75, and Adam and Eve ~3.7-4.0 words/s: the draft was under 14 min, at the QA's 165 words a minute ceiling, and five talking lines too short for a 4 s clip (TALK_LINE_RETIME_OVER at the build)

runs.name: final draft text (longer talking lines), long line gap 0.6 s
runs.plan_estimate: 874.1 s with long_plan_check's measured pace by voice and 0.6 s gap: within 0.3 %

used_by: long_plan_check.VOICE_PACE (first run) and LONG_LINE_GAP 0.6 s; the long's build must lay its lines with the same gap (LONG_DESIGN.md slice 3)
also_for_the_shorts: plan_check (Shorts) times every line, a character's too, at 2.75 words/s: a character's talking line is ~35 % faster in fact, so a Short plan can pass with a talking line the build then refuses (TALK_LINE_RETIME_OVER). Not changed here (a Short gate); reported to the coordinator.
